classification.difficultyReason: Compare race durations in hours, minutes and seconds, building across a whole minute.

content.prompt: Three people ran the Canberra marathon; their times were 2:43:52 (2 hours 43 minutes 52 seconds), 2:46:57 and 2:47:15. What were the time differences between the first and second competitors, and between the second and third?

children.label: a
children.prompt: Between the first and second competitors.

answer.worked:
Build up from 2:43:52 to 2:44:00: 8 seconds.

From 2:44:00 to 2:46:00: 2 minutes.

From 2:46:00 to 2:46:57: 57 seconds.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference}&=2\text{ min}+8\text{ s}+57\text{ s}\\\text{Difference}&=3\text{ min }5\text{ s}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Between the second and third competitors.

answer.worked:
Build up from 2:46:57 to 2:47:00: 3 seconds.

From 2:47:00 to 2:47:15: 15 seconds.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference}&=3\text{ s}+15\text{ s}\\\text{Difference}&=18\text{ s}\end{align*}$$
